vendor_api_version: Slack Web API as documented on 2026-09-26

divergences.reason: upload_url points at the host the client called (/upload/v1/{file_id} on the app emulator, following X-Forwarded-Host behind the LocalStack gateway). Slack points it at files.slack.com.
divergences.operator_note: Operator-approved plan for WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin #325, 2026-10-01: the upload stays on the app emulator.

divergences.reason: An upload body over 10 MiB answers HTTP 413, the twincore request body cap. Slack's limit is not stated in the 2026-09-26 docs capture.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-01: log the gap (WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin #325). Raising the kit cap is a separate fleet decision.

divergences.reason: Any non-empty authorization code is accepted, once. The app emulator serves no slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize page, so no code is issued for the user's approval and none expires after ten minutes.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-02 (WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin #327): accept any non-empty code; the research Arazzo workflow takes the code as an input.

divergences.reason: The granted bot scopes are a fixed set (chat:write, channels:read, users:read), and token rotation is not served: tokens do not expire and grant_type=refresh_token answers invalid_refresh_token.
Any well-formed xoxb-, xoxp- or xapp- token is accepted as the default principal of its type. Slack answers invalid_auth for a token it did not issue.
divergences.operator_note: Operator-approved plan for WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin #321, 2026-10-01: tokens need not be seeded first.

divergences.reason: Scopes are not enforced: missing_scope is never returned and the x-accepted-oauth-scopes header is not sent. So chat.postMessage and files.completeUploadExternal never answer not_in_channel: Slack refuses a post to a public channel the caller is not in unless the app has chat:write.public (chat.postMessage docs, Channel membership), and the app emulator lets any caller post to any channel.
divergences.operator_note: Deferred by the operator, 2026-10-01: scopes are PR 3b, after a refresh run captures the scope headers.

divergences.reason: trigger_id is not checked (never expired_trigger_id, exchanged_trigger_id or invalid_trigger_id) and the two-push limit is not enforced. The app emulator issues no triggers until interactivity is served.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-02 (WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin #326): open and push wait for Events and interactivity.

divergences.reason: Rate limits are not enforced: no method answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Calling a paginated method without pagination gets no stricter limit, and no rate tier is assigned to any method, so the docs and the Java SDK disagreeing on the tier of 24 methods has no effect.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-02: rate limits are not simulated in the community app emulator; simulating them likely belongs to the commercial emulator. This is a decision for Slack, not a standing rule for other app emulators.

divergences.reason: Every caller gets the documented page sizes: history defaults to 100 messages per call and replies to 1000, with no per-minute limit. Since 2025-05-29 Slack caps both methods at 15 messages per call, and one call per minute, for new commercially distributed apps not listed in the Slack Marketplace (changelog 2025-05-29). The app emulator answers as Slack does for an app the cap does not apply to, such as an internal or Marketplace app.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-07: declare, not simulate. The cap is a rate limit tied to commercial distribution, which the community app emulator does not simulate (see the rate-limit entry), and copying it would break paging in customers' tests.

divergences.route: Events API HTTP delivery and interactivity
divergences.reason: Events API HTTP delivery is served for five events: message from chat.postMessage, message_deleted from chat.delete, reaction_added from reactions.add, member_joined_channel from conversations.join and conversations.invite, and member_left_channel from conversations.leave and conversations.kick. Each is signed and retried with x-slack-retry-num and x-slack-retry-reason, a failure answered with x-slack-no-retry: 1 is not retried, and setting a Request URL through POST /admin/events/config makes the url_verification handshake (--webhook-url at startup does not). The channel_type on member_joined_channel and member_left_channel, C for a public channel and G for a private one, is unverified because Slack's reference page for those events is not in the captured docs. Not served: the other events Slack sends for these writes (message_changed, the channel_join message, pin_added, channel and file events, app_mention and the rest), Socket Mode and interactivity payloads. too_many_redirects is never the retry reason, Delayed Events and the failure-rate disabling of subscriptions are not modelled, and every event goes to the configured Request URL whatever the app's subscriptions or channel membership. The retry schedule defaults to Slack's (nearly immediately, 1 minute, 5 minutes) and can be shortened through POST /admin/events/config.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (research/twins/slack/mvp.md section 9): Events API HTTP delivery is in the MVP; Socket Mode, modals and agents stay deferred. Operator decision, 2026-10-06: fill gaps for anything Slack has not deprecated, so member events, url_verification and x-slack-no-retry are served; the events beyond the five served are follow-ups.

divergences.reason: Answers unknown_method before authentication. Slack sunset files.upload on 2025-11-12 (changelog 2025-03-17), but the 2026-09-26 unauthenticated probe (obs-004) shows Slack still routes the name to its auth check. Use files.getUploadURLExternal and files.completeUploadExternal.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-06: remove methods Slack has retired or degraded rather than serve or declare them.

divergences.reason: Answers unknown_method. Slack still serves these methods, but its July 2023 changelog ("It's later already for stars and reminders") calls them degraded or useless since Save it for Later replaced both features.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-06: remove methods Slack has retired or degraded rather than serve or declare them.
divergences.no_quirk_reason: Removal of degraded methods; no vendor behaviour is reproduced or departed from beyond the method being absent.

divergences.route: POST /api/{method} for any method outside the supported use cases
divergences.reason: Answers unknown_method. Slack serves these methods; the app emulator supports only the methods its use cases need (research/twins/slack/mvp.md). Every Slack method marked recommended_scope deferred in research/twins/slack/method-inventory.json in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs is in this set, each with its revisit trigger in scope-recommendation.json. The 15 stubs the first build served for deferred methods (dialog.open, dnd.*, search.*, team.accessLogs, team.billableInfo, team.integrationLogs, team.profile.get, users.setPhoto, users.deletePhoto) were removed rather than kept as answers that looked real.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-10-06: state exactly what is supported; methods outside the supported use cases are not served and are declared once here instead of one entry per method.
divergences.no_quirk_reason: A scope boundary, not a departure from a documented or observed Slack behaviour.

divergences.reason: With a JSON body, query-string arguments are ignored. Slack's docs say not to mix a JSON body with query-string or form arguments ("Choose one approach per request", apis/web-api) but not how Slack answers a request that does. Mixing a query string with a form body is documented as allowed, and the app emulator merges the two.
divergences.operator_note: Operator rule, 2026-10-06: where the captured references do not settle a behaviour, declare it rather than invent it.

divergences.reason: icon_url is accepted but not reflected on the message, because the captured references show no shape for it; username and icon_emoji are reflected. unfurl_links, unfurl_media and unfurl_app_links have no effect: the app emulator does not unfurl links.
divergences.operator_note: Operator rule, 2026-10-06: where the captured references do not settle a behaviour, declare it rather than invent it.
divergences.no_quirk_reason: Gaps in the captured references and in what the app emulator renders, not a recorded Slack quirk.

divergences.reason: There is no USLACK system user, and no system notifications are sent. Since 2026-06-17 Slack sends system notifications from USLACK rather than Slackbot.
divergences.operator_note: Operator rule, 2026-10-06: where the captured references do not settle a behaviour, declare it rather than invent it.

divergences.reason: One app state is reproduced: a granular Slack app. Behaviour that Slack varies by app creation date or app type (research versioning.md section 2) is not modelled.
